title: Transactions
hints: Register **one** deferred function right after a successful `Begin`. It is the single place that decides whether to roll back, so every exit path — `return err` or panic — goes through it. A `committing := false` flag tells it when the commit path was reached.

In the deferred function: `if committing { return }`. Then `if r := recover(); r != nil { _ = tx.Rollback(); panic(r) }` (roll back, then re-panic the same value). Otherwise the callback returned an error: `if rerr := tx.Rollback(); rerr != nil { err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("rollback: %w", rerr)) }` — this needs the **named** `err` result.

The body: `if err := fn(tx); err != nil { return err }`, then `committing = true` and `if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("commit: %w", err) }`. `ExecAll` is `return WithTx(db, func(tx Tx) error { for _, stmt := range stmts { if err := tx.Exec(stmt); err != nil { return fmt.Errorf("exec %q: %w", stmt, err) } }; return nil })`.
